blurb: Linear and affine maps from rank–nullity and duality to least squares, Gauss–Markov, linear programming and ReLUs.

pics.alt: Four red data points with a blue least-squares line and green vertical residual segments
pics.caption: A least-squares fit to the data (1, 6), (2, 5), (3, 7), (4, 10): the blue line y = 3.5 + 1.4x minimises the sum of the squared vertical residuals shown in green.
pics.title: Linear least squares example2.svg

pics.alt: A green three-dimensional polytope with a red path running along its edges
pics.caption: The feasible region of a linear programme in three variables is a polytope; the red path shows how the simplex method can move along edges from vertex to vertex towards an optimum.
pics.title: Simplex-method-3-dimensions.png
